svg.title: ThingsBoard 3.6 Relation 创建、查询与删除完整时序

g.text: ThingsBoard 3.6 Relation 创建、查询与删除完整时序
check WRITE permission on both endpoints
log actions for from and to
push two entity action TbMsg records
Relation DB, cache eviction, Edge event,
audit and Rule Engine messages are not one transaction.
check READ on from, then to
rollback cache transaction; do not fill
find outgoing or incoming list by root/direction/group
select child by FROM/TO and deduplicate entityId
add all / max-level / early-leaf edges to result Set
maxLevel <= 0 becomes effectively unbounded Java traversal.
The default 20-second Future timeout is not a DB statement timeout.
Cache eviction and RELATION_DELETED are published
even when the existed flag is false.
failed audit action; no Rule Engine TbMsg
find all incoming and outgoing edges
publish one cache event per pre-read edge
The relation table has no endpoint foreign keys or DB cascade.
A caught concurrency exception only proves that Java statements continue.
The transaction may be rollback-only, so final commit must be checked.
delete entity row in outer transaction
[EntityRelation overload: Future failed or delete returned false]
Bulk Rule Node delete uses the EntityRelation overload.
